text: Hobbies and interests. What do you like doing? Playing the guitar. I like playing the guitar in music class. Reading books. I like reading books in the library. Drawing. I love drawing with crayons. Watching TV. I like watching TV on the weekend. Cooking. I love cooking for my parents. Singing. I love singing in front of people. Dancing. I love dancing to hip-hop music. Listening to music. I love listening to music before I go to sleep. Playing games. I love playing games with my brother. Swimming. I enjoy swimming in the ocean. Hiking. I like going hiking in the mountains. Taking photographs. I love taking photos of my pet. Playing basketball. I love playing basketball after school. Riding a bicycle. I enjoy riding a bicycle at the park. Review!
